per_row.label: answer
turns: How many unused vacation days can I carry over to next year?
replies:
You can carry over up to **5 unused annual leave days** to the next calendar year. These carried-over days must be used by **31 March** of that year; otherwise, they will expire. Any days above the carry-over limit will expire on **31 December** of the current year.

Sources: [leave-policy §3.4]

per_row.label: answer
turns: Do I get paid sick leave?
replies: As a contractor at Lumora Tech, you do not receive paid sick leave. The sick leave policy applies only to full-time and part-time employees, and contractors are advised to inform their manager about any absence according to their service agreement [sick-leave-policy §1.1].

per_row.label: clarify_then_referral
replies: For how many days do you plan to work from abroad?

As a full-time employee, you can work from abroad for up to 30 calendar days per calendar year. Since you plan to work for about 2 months (approximately 60 days), this exceeds the allowed duration. For stays longer than 30 days, HR must decide on your request individually, so you will need to contact HR for further assistance regarding your situation.

Sources: [remote-work-policy §3.1], [remote-work-policy §3.2]
